create_BasicEncoder: create a BasicEncoder neural network that extracts multi-scale feature maps from input images with configurable output dimensions
create_ShallowEncoder: create a ShallowEncoder neural network with configurable normalization for lightweight feature extraction from images
create_EfficientUpdateFormer: create an EfficientUpdateFormer transformer that updates track estimates using time and optional space attention blocks with virtual tracks
build_CorrBlock: build a CorrBlock that constructs a multi-level correlation pyramid for matching track features across frames
build_EfficientCorrBlock: build an EfficientCorrBlock that samples correlations between target features and a feature pyramid at given coordinates
